  if(!e){e=Date.now()+30*60*1000;try{sessionStorage.setItem(k,e);}catch(x){}}
  function u(){
    var d=Math.max(0,parseInt(e)-Date.now());
    var m=Math.floor(d/60000),s=Math.floor((d%60000)/1000);

    var me=document.getElementById('t-m'),se=document.getElementById('t-s');
    if(me)me.textContent=p(m);if(se)se.textContent=p(s);

      }
    }
  }

})();

// Live visitor counter — varía entre 40 y 60
(function(){
  var base = 40 + Math.floor(Math.random()*20);
  var el = document.getElementById('live-count');
  if(!el) return;
  el.textContent = base + ' personas';
  setInterval(function(){
    var delta = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
    base = Math.max(38, Math.min(65, base + delta));
    if(el) el.textContent = base + ' personas';
  }, 8000);
})();
